Contacting Support - Support hours
The Brindlewick Audio support team is available Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern Time. Support is closed on weekends and US public holidays.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/refunds.md">
Returns and Refunds - Return window
You can return any Brindlewick Audio product within 30 days of the delivery date. The item must include its original packaging and all accessories. Returns requested after the 30 day window are not accepted.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/payments.md">
Payments - Accepted payment methods
Brindlewick Audio accepts Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal. Cash on delivery and personal checks are not accepted. All prices are charged in US dollars.
</document>
